notes.title: New Trailer, 4 Months of Demo Updates, and Festival News!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]For the last four months, I've been working hard behind the scenes, pushing over 30 patches to the demo. The in-game feedback system I implemented has worked wonders! Based on your suggestions, I've reworked core systems, added new content, and implemented numerous quality-of-life improvements. Thank you all so much for your invaluable feedback![/p][h3][b]Brand New Gameplay Trailer![/b][/h3][p]I've launched a brand new gameplay trailer! The previous one was too long, a bit slow, and didn't show much gameplay. This new one is shorter, packed with action, and focuses on the core gameplay experience. Check it out here![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hixt1IFO7yg"][/dynamiclink][b]
Tiny Teams Festival![/b][/p][p]On top of that, I'm thrilled to announce that the game will be part of the [b]Tiny Teams Festival[/b], which runs from [b]August 7th, 6 PM BST to August 14th, 6 PM BST[/b]! As a solo developer, it's a huge honor to be included alongside so many amazing games from other small teams. I suggest checking out the other games joining the festival as well![/p][p]There will also be a livestream on [b]August 9th[/b] by a couple of Twitch streamers. I will announce the time once it's set.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37927499/23965aacba5ab558e316f77b6b62e6647b1359d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What's New?[/b][/h3][p]Let's dive into what's new in the demo![/p][p][b]System Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Reputation System:[/b] The old "Popularity" system has been completely overhauled and replaced by a tier-based system with a new UI that provides a detailed breakdown of all contributing factors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Happiness System:[/b] This system has been reworked to provide more detailed information on villager status, including a new happiness bonus for Food Variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laborer's Lodge:[/b] "Unemployed" villagers are now designated as "Laborers." They reside in the new Laborer's Lodge building, located near the docks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Workplace Ambience:[/b] Decorations now provide a "Workplace Ambience" bonus, increasing the happiness of workers in nearby buildings. During their bloom season, Cherry Trees also increase the happiness of nearby workers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Building - Orchard Keeper’s Hut:[/b] This building is dedicated to growing trees that provide periodic harvests after a long maturation period.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lord Customization:[/b] Leader portraits and their bonuses ("Paths") are now separate systems, so you can customize your lord's appearance without being tied to specific bonuses. I have also added 5 more Paths with unique bonuses and several new portraits, including five female options![/p][/*][*][p][b]Military Formations:[/b] Units will now automatically form formations based on their attack range when given a move order. Melee units will create a frontline to protect ranged units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Garrisoning:[/b] You can now order units to garrison behind your gates for better defense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building Sizes:[/b] Warehouse and Well sizes have been reduced to free up more building space in your town.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Update:[/b] Hunters now collect Meat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Basic Starting Ship:[/b] The initial Tier 0 ship has been replaced with a more basic vessel that can only travel to nearby clans.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37927499/9d25f68c1c2f500a4a030aa85567f99165f91a4f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Town Management Hub:[/b] The top-right UI has been condensed into a single button to reduce clutter and open the new hub. You can also pin the buttons you use most to the main HUD.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Management Panels:[/b] The hub gives you access to several new panels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Buildings Panel:[/b] View all buildings and manage their assigned workers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Construction Queue Panel:[/b] View and re-order active construction projects by dragging them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Town Overview Panel:[/b] Check lord info, map details, and customize your town’s global aesthetics. (You will also be able to host festivals from here in the future!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Collapsible HUD:[/b] The entire HUD is made of collapsible elements for a cleaner view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Navigation:[/b] The main navigation buttons have been moved to the bottom center of the screen for easier access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clear Menu Titles:[/b] All menus now clearly display their names at the top for easier navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Guides:[/b] The in-game guide and tutorial popups have been updated with clearer instructions to reflect the latest changes.[/p][/*][/list][p][i][b]Here is Before/After of the UI:[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37927499/29e043bc05f1dc7ac3d54dd2b13313cfd37c1a40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/36cc8cbe4826867e62fd9beb147dda725b08faeb.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37927499/f6427a844fb74a88d98c6849f809ff19eb83e50f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Building Placement:[/b] You can now place buildings directly on top of trees to automatically clear them. The UI will also clearly display why a building cannot be placed in a specific location.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Live Building Warnings:[/b] Building warning/error icons now update live. They will also warn you if a new building is too far from essential structures like a road or warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Builder AI:[/b] The logic for builders has been improved for more efficient construction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detailed Unit List:[/b] The unit list now displays more detailed status info, showing if units are filling a job, assigned to a ship, or garrisoned. You can also assign or change a soldier's squad directly from this menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mercenary Hiring Options:[/b] You now have two options for hiring mercenaries: hire them for a single day or hire them permanently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soldier to Worker Conversion:[/b] A feature has been added to turn soldiers back into workers via the unit list.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Go to Camp Button:[/b] A new button has been added to quickly send selected soldiers back to their camp.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical Pause UI:[/b] The pause UI now includes a pulsing screen border and on-screen text, making it much more obvious that the game is paused.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Notification History:[/b] A notification history panel has been added, complete with categories and filters to help you manage past alerts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detailed Resource Info:[/b] You can now see a detailed breakdown of where resources are stored or being used, as well as the average net change over the last three days.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visible Growth & Yield:[/b] You can now see the remaining growth time and expected yield for your crops and trees.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cancel Research:[/b] You can now cancel research that is currently in progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escape Key Functionality:[/b] The Escape key now deselects units, cancels building placement, and closes open panels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//37927499/effdcab0f593214f85bc35473fb7e1177b68b434.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Controls & Settings Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Control Remapping:[/b] The remapping system has been reworked to support key combinations (e.g., Ctrl+1) and non-Latin characters. Many of the default hotkeys have been changed to be more modern and no longer depend on the middle mouse button. New remappings have been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessibility Menu:[/b] An Accessibility Settings button has been added to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Settings Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto Pause Menus[/p][/*][*][p]Pause On Focus Loss[/p][/*][*][p]Invert Mouse Zoom[/p][/*][*][p]Pan & Scrolling Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle Notifications[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Notification Duration & Colors[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]There are also a lot of other improvements and bug fixes that I may have forgotten to add here![/p][h3][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h3][p]My current focus is on adding more waves to the game so we can run a beta test with longer gameplay sessions. This was delayed because I've been prioritizing implementing your feedback and polishing the demo.[/p][p]While I can't announce a release date just yet, please rest assured that I am working towards it. Thank you all for your incredible support![/p][p]Feel free to join the Discord! If you haven't joined yet, you can always contact me there.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/MZWbn4vzTS"]https://discord.com/invite/MZWbn4vzTS[/url] [/p]

notes.title: Research System: Discover, Adapt, and Evolve!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I hope this message finds you well. I've been hard at work on some exciting new features for Faraway Lands, and I'm thrilled to share them one of them with you today. One of the most significant additions is the new Research System, designed to add depth, strategy, and replayability.

[h2][b]Scholars: The Minds Behind Progress[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/b0a8ca8c0aca42b80c1b7f0182d6e7772b116e26.gif[/img]
Research in your settlement is conducted by scholars working in pagodas. These learned individuals are the driving force behind your technological advancement. Like other workers, scholars have unique traits that can affect their research efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/a1729a06a93d68215576aa847082cb4dba7feaf0.png[/img]
Your research progress is influenced by multiple factors:

[b]Scholar Count[/b](This is not linear, each scholar after 4th adds 10% to overall research speed)
[b]Scholar Traits[/b]
[b]Researches[/b]
[b]Temporary/Permanent Bonuses from Random Events[/b]

[h2][b]Four Paths to Progress[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/2be5098c15a081c8c0d76ac8a5dbc42c97b7f08d.gif[/img]
The research system is divided into four distinct branches (Production & Resources, Trading & Exploration, Military & Defense, and Culture & Wellbeing), each representing a different aspect of your settlement's development. Each branch has four tiers of advancement, allowing you to specialize or diversify your town's capabilities as you see fit.

[h2][b]Dynamic Research Choices[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/0cd8a275f4e69f38849f3ea7000a1285a5a56c23.gif[/img]
To keep each playthrough fresh and engaging, the Research System offers a randomized selection of research options. After completing a research project, you're presented with random new choices. This system encourages strategic adaptation, as you'll need to make the best of the options available to you.

[h2][b]Tiered Progression[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/05d19819502ecebe0bc3a6a77dd7dea621dcaa25.gif[/img]
As you complete research projects, you'll earn points toward advancing to the next tier. Each new tier automatically unlocks certain researches and opens up more powerful research options. For example, reaching Tier 2 in Production automatically unlocks basic building upgrades, while Culture Tier 2 provides additional research choices.

[h2][b]Branch Focusing[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/a23520a15188da35b71dd4a194ef4fbac809bcf4.gif[/img]
Want more control over the direction of your town's development? You can focus on specific research branches by right-clicking on them. This increases the likelihood of receiving research options from that branch, allowing you to specialize and strategize according to your preferences.

[h2][b]Customizable Experience[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/9748369206275494038356eda59554fd90578aa4.gif[/img]
Not everybody is a fan of RNG. So to reduce it and enhance accessibility and replayability, I've added a customization option that increases the amount of choices you get for the Research System.

[h2][b]Hidden Discoveries[/b][/h2]
Not all research options are readily available. Some must be discovered through:

[h3][b]Trading with Other Countries[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/85d56a96a5b67bc8c6eeef9f8924fa10cc65beb2.gif[/img]
Establish trade routes and build relationships to unlock unique researches.

[h3][b]Random Events[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/9f8a36dc97a1c69c3bb426975ec0c46cb0e7353d.gif[/img]
Keep an eye out for special events that grant access to exclusive research opportunities.

[h3][b]Exploring the Underworld[/b][/h3]
Send your soldiers into the depths to uncover secrets and powerful technologies.

[h2][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h2]
As always, your feedback is crucial to refining Faraway Lands. While the Research System is now complete, I'm committed to evolving it based on community insights during playtesting. Numerous additional improvements and fixes are in the works, which I'll detail in an upcoming dev log. Unfortunately, I don't have a release date to share just yet! :(

notes.title: Next Fest Recap, New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since I last posted, and I apologize for the lack of news. The past few months have been quite busy for me. I had a wedding in August and a contract job that ended just before the wedding. Neither of us had our own house or furniture, so we spent a lot of time looking for rentals and furniture while also planning the wedding. It’s been hectic! However, I’ve had more free time in the last couple of weeks, and development has been going very well.

As many of you know, I attended the Steam Next Fest in February, and it was a blast! I received incredibly valuable and heartwarming feedback from the community. I kept the demo available until the end of March, during which time I fixed bugs and added some small features.

[h2][b]Your Feedback Makes a Difference![/b][/h2]

I truly appreciate all the constructive feedback. The features I've implemented below are thanks to you! I plan to share more exciting updates in future devlogs, which I intend to post much more frequently.

[b][h2]Soldier Squads & Easier Soldier Management[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/448aa3a1d08a99389b1324d8450196bcd59e8fa8.gif[/img]
Selecting the soldiers you want can be challenging. Now, you can create designated squads for different tasks, like mining or expeditions. You can even customize squad banners and names for easier management.

[b][h2]Easier Worker Management[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/4dadd9f333b70691bfe1ef0729e516fa1bb7ad19.gif[/img]
Previously, unassigning workers from buildings to replace them was cumbersome, as you had to wait for them to finish their tasks. Now, you can quickly replace workers and see their traits just by hovering over the slots.

[b][h2]Better Priority System[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/8adcc853fa0fb385185ceb6027b8664233522895.gif[/img]
Many players found the priority system unintuitive. I’ve revamped it to make it clearer, with better explanations and visual feedback.

[b][h2]Trait Filters[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/313a6176d06ce5c164c65d0b56a4e006c6c81f2e.gif[/img]
You can now filter workers based on economic and combat traits, making it easier to manage your workforce in the late game when you have many workers.

[b][h2]Customizable Difficulty Settings[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/b624fd3e2fe7762ed898bf3e959629af7326ae41.gif[/img]
I noticed the existing difficulty options didn’t suit everyone, so I made many game parameters customizable. You can adjust the frequency of raids, weather, events, resources, and more, making the game more accessible and replayable.

[b][h2]Custom Control Bindings[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/2c95b45844f021d4dced5f5fb2e6845dda8d1a10.gif[/img]
Control bindings are a standard feature in games, and I’ve now added this option, which was missing from the demo.

[b][h2]Workplace Warnings[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/f5522de22e9624bd31d8be509c126c037328c6c9.gif[/img]
It’s easy to overlook certain tasks, like assigning a worker or building a well. Now, small warning icons appear above buildings in those situations. You can toggle this feature with the Z key if you find it distracting.

[b][h2]Building Names[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/b0e749963b4c859ed13aa14f718bc57eaca73315.gif[/img]
Many players had difficulty recognizing buildings, so you can now hold the Alt key to display their names.

[b][h2]Detailed Resource Info[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/5b784762f758f93ecbd2678a2c4f7465135d258e.png[/img]
You can now see how many resources are in your markets, warehouses, pending delivery (when a worker is carrying them or they’re on the ground), as well as food consumption.

Additionally, there are many other small improvements and bug fixes

In the next devlog, I’ll discuss replayability and the features I’m adding to enhance it. Thank you all for your continued support and patience!

notes.title: Still Alive: Major Game Updates
notes.content:
First off, I sincerely apologize for the silence. This being my first game, I quite underestimated the time and skills needed for game development. The complexity of blending multiple genres in one game, I've learned, is quite challenging for a beginner developer. I've also realized that I tend to get fixated on small details, which, while important, often led me to spend more time than necessary on certain aspects of the game. This sometimes resulted in less productivity than I would have liked.

A significant turning point came a few years back when my game engine, GameMaker Studio, received a major update. This necessitated a complete rewrite of my codebase, which, unsurprisingly, was a bit of a spaghetti mess. It pushed me to dive deeper into the world of programming – I've since been educating myself on game development, learning languages like C++ and C#, and even branching out into Unity. This journey also led me to redo much of the game's art.

In the midst of all this, I had to balance making a living, which naturally took up a considerable amount of my time. I also took on a contract job using my Unity skills, which lasted a few months.

Like many developers before me, I fell into the trap of feature creep. It's a tough lesson that I guess one has to experience firsthand to fully grasp!

Looking back, I see all these experiences as part of the journey. However, the weight of not having released the game after all these years is heavy on me. So, I've made a decision – the game will be released this year. I plan to continue updating and improving it post-launch.

Your patience and support have been invaluable throughout this long development process. It’s your encouragement that has kept me going, especially in times of doubt and challenge. Without it, I might have given up a long time ago.

I have never quit on the game and will never do so. I have always been active on discord and you can always message me there and I will answer you as soon as possible.

Let's move on to the changes I have made!

As there are quite a few, I will now explain them shortly and leave the details to further devlogs, which from now on will be frequent.

[h1]Revamped Visuals[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/6b7b8c8431279f2cd23aec0fb96c7e4f77ca03ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/37f8015f2bd7a8f49f8749d62b81fdd90afe1b53.png[/img]

I think the new trailer will feature this the best.

[previewyoutube=qy_6gblr3gA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1] Mountain Terrain [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/c01475764742a8646558fa39109b2a634144b06d.png[/img]

One challenge with side-scrollers is the limited building space, which often leads to excessive scrolling. However, I've developed a solution that seems to be working well. The game now unfolds on a mountain or hill, featuring multiple levels. This approach not only makes the game feel larger but also significantly reduces the need for scrolling. Additionally, it cuts down on transportation time between buildings and provides players with more strategic options, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

I have got the idea from the japanese hill-top castles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/acd6b83725a93559ab3779cf117f14a7cb531578.jpg[/img]

[h1] Smarter Villagers[/h1]

I have always enjoyed the atmospheres of classic games like Settlers and Knights and Merchants, where watching villagers go about their daily lives was a joy. In shaping my game, I've aimed to capture that same essence. So as a result you don't control the villagers directly. Instead, you assign them to workplaces—which also serve as their homes—based on their traits, and they live autonomously, which also reduces the micro aspect of the game a little.
Each villager has their own needs, such as hunger, thirst, warmth, and happiness. For instance, when thirsty, they'll head to a nearby well, or they'll visit the market to stock up on food for their homes. They also gather essentials like firewood and clothes from the market. An added touch of realism is that the villagers now sleep each night, further enhancing the dynamic feel of a living, breathing community. I believe this approach adds a layer of realism and allows you to immerse yourself in the self-sustaining community you've helped create.

[h1] Production Chains [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/71142d106b6c8d65c0ab1a1136fa0a6751a0d847.gif[/img]

Another updated feature is the production chains, reminiscent of the detailed economic mechanics in those classic titles. For instance, you can see the transformation of raw materials into essential goods: logs are turned into lumber, rice is brewed into sake, and so forth.

[h1] Better Japanese Roots[/h1]

When I first released the demo, I received feedback that some elements, like the mountains in the background and certain buildings & units, had a more Chinese appearance. This prompted me to delve deeper into Japanese culture and history, leading to several enhancements in the game. While my goal is to maintain a fantasy setting, I still want the game to reflect Japanese cultural elements more accurately.

To address this, I've updated the background and building sprites to better match the Japanese aesthetic. The monks have been transformed into Onmyoji, reflecting a more authentic aspect of Japanese lore. I've removed the crossbowman unit, now making it a unique mercenary that players can hire. Additionally, I've introduced small details such as animations for praying at a Shinto shrine, among other updates. These changes are part of my ongoing effort to create a game world that, while fantastical, still resonates with the rich tapestry of Japanese culture.

[h1] A Lively Environment [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/435e784ee8af3fa52c7b49b68722f767f87df2f6.gif[/img]

A key focus in developing the game has been to create a more vibrant and lively environment. To achieve this, I've introduced distinct sprites for male and female villagers, adding diversity and realism to the village life. Children have also been added, and they can be seen engaging in various activities around the village, further enhancing the dynamic nature of the game world. The addition of animals like dogs, birds, and deer brings an extra layer of life and movement. Moreover, I've included a giant waterfall and an array of colorful flowers, enriching the game's visual appeal and making the environment feel truly alive and bustling.


[h1] Dynamic Weather System [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/64139c5b5077d6805c2e1b97581344f849e34c50.gif[/img]

Additionally, I've implemented a dynamic weather system in the game. Not only does it enhance the visual appeal of the environment – which I personally find quite stunning – but it also introduces various effects that you, as the player, will experience. This system brings the game world to life, requiring you to adapt to changing weather conditions that directly impact your strategy and interactions within the game.

[h1] Better Code & Quality of Life Features[/h1]

I've made several enhancements to improve your gameplay experience. Now, you can scale the game's UI to your preference, ensuring better accessibility and comfort. I've also introduced multiple zoom levels with a smooth zoom function, providing a more seamless and detailed view of the game world. Additionally, the game now supports 1440p resolution, offering sharper and clearer visuals. I've unlocked the frame rate for a smoother gameplay experience and have fixed numerous bugs. Along with these fixes, I've implemented a variety of quality-of-life features to enrich your overall gaming experience.

[h2] A lot New Features such as Lords & Artifax, Tax Mechanic and much more...[/h2]

There are a lot of things that have been changed but it's already a wall of text so I will explain those in the upcoming devlogs.

Additionally, I've updated our Steam store page with a new trailer and fresh screenshots, along with a detailed, gif-enhanced description now available in 8 languages. Look forward to an extra gameplay trailer in a couple of months!

[h1]Upcoming Steam Next Festival[/h1]

I will be attending the upcoming Steam Next Festival with a demo which will begin at 5th of February so you can try out the update demo then.

Thank you for your patience, have a great day.

notes.title: #Devlog-End of Demo,Current Progression
notes.content:
Hello guys, hope you are well & safe!

I will first talk about how the demo experience was for me and then inform you about updates.

[h3][b]Demo[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] It has been a month since I published the demo,It was a pretty crazy week for me, I was late for the festival, couldn't manage to finish the demo in time.After 3 stressful and sleepless days into the festival I managed to release the demo.And...I got my first crash report in a few mins from the playersːsteamhappyː
[*] There were a lot of bugs so the first people who played the game probably quit & never returned, but I managed to fix them rather quickly, so after a few days it was running fine mostly.I kept updating the demo, fixing,changing & adding few things based on feedback & my observations.
[*] Overall, it was a great experience.Even though I missed most of the festival, it got the attention of a few youtubers which has gained us quite a bit of new players(We are at 4.5k whishlists right now)! It gave me a chance to observe how people play the game, which I noticed can be quite different than I intended.
[*] The demo was supposed to last during the festival only, but I decided to let it stay for a while.Today I am going to take it down after almost a month, we are down to 2-3 demo downloads per day and it is a hassle to keep both versions running among other reasons.I hope to make available again some day.

[*] I want to thank everyone who participated in the demo and I hope guys had fun.
[b]Note:[/b][i]You can still contact me and I will happily send you a key for the demo.[/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]Updates[/b][/h3]

I have noticed a lot of people have an hard time to manage their villagers and often can't find the ones they need.So I have implemented two solutions for that.
[b]First one [/b]is a list of buttons that shows how many villagers are assigned to each job
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/ecfb74f5a97e971d8c16420f744c87e544900cb6.gif[/img]
It is an easy tool to navigate through villagers(No more lost villagers, yay!)

[b]Second one[/b] is a list of villagers, this is more complex but it also shows villagers traits and you can change their name, this one is useful to pinpoint your target villager.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/609fc5f348a84000e58065001da2fd97ad72452f.gif[/img]

[b]Save system [/b]kinda broke while I was rushing things for the festival, so I started fixing it.Lucky for me my game engine recieved another update which made the old data structures I used for saving absolute, so I rewrote the entire save system which took a week.But it works much better now, and I know the save is one of the most important things, nobody likes losing their progress!(Technical note: old data structures were not garbage collected so it let to memory leaks and other kind of problems if I forgot to delete or something)
I have added 6 manual save slots, also 1 more for quick save and 2 more for auto saves(which happens every day and after important events)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/03650a7fe2db1b5b451ccfb26cdcfab0e944f406.gif[/img]

[b]Researching[/b]
I have changed the system from a tree to an exploration based mechanic, which I think suits better to the game.The system works like this:You assign your villagers to become librarians in the dungeon libraries and gain research point as they work there.You can then use those points to [i]research scrolls/books[/i].You come across those rare books throug secret rooms in the dungeons,trading with other cities, or some islands on the map(I will come back to this)
Those researches are permanent and grant bonuses based on their rarity(From some minor buffs to new technologies, new villager or soldier skills,buildings etc)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/49517da0b9f0f60c74269f2ffa94a9d912a6c5b1.gif[/img]

[b]Islands[/b]
I have added a new concept, you can come across mysterious islands on the oceans,to which you can send your soldiers and explore.These are like little side quests, you get a book from each of them and some small rewards.I have planned 4 for now and I don't intend to include more as I need to finish the core game first.
Here is a sneak peak at one:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/8429c4b1d2ace2e24ad2243375154a869c483e9b.gif[/img]

[b]Dungeons[/b]
Previously there could only be 1 stairs per level in the dungeons, which limited the layout.I have  rewritten the dungeon system as well,villagers are smarter.Now I can make more interesting layouts.I am also working on a system so that I will be able to create 3-4 slightly different layouts so that if you restart the game the rooms will be placed slightly different.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/4bbfe2edeadb5706b26dea1ea0ac5ccd3ea45cdb.png[/img]
Couple notes about that layout(which is just an example), vertically expanding the dungeons introduced another problem: long walking times between surface and dungeons.I think I have fixed it by dividing the dungeon into 3 sections.After you kill the sections boss a portal appears to another section, which is connected to all other portals.So you can directly travel to level 4 of the dungeons through the main ground portal.It also makes the design look more interesting!I will post more on dungeons in another devlog.

[b]Next Up[/b]
So as I observed from people playing the game there were two major issues:Selection of villagers & long travel time between stockpile and buildings.I fixed the first one, and now I am working on the second one, which has been nightmare.I made it so that people deposit resources to their respective buildings(lumberjacks to woodcutter's camp instead of stockpile) and I  changed the "ore_carrier" building to "Carrier's Hut" so that workers there grab resources from the connected buildings(woodcutters,fisherman,blacksmith etc.) and deliver it to the stockpile.
When you build a new building it connects itself to the nearest "Carrier's Hut".You can later delete the building from the connection list and connect it to another hut.The carriers will start going to buildings once there are enough resources stored in the building.You can change the minimum required resource amount for the carrier to move too.But it introduces another layers of problems and can be quite complex mechanic for many players so I am trying to simplify it..If anyone have any suggestions,I would be more than happy to hear it!
Once I hopefully finish that part of the game,which is a big part even though it might seem minor, I will make the enemies smarter, they currently have targetting issues.And then I will start adding more enemies and filling the dungeons and ocean.

I will announce when I make a closed beta, but don't expect it too soon.I am done giving dates since I fail to meet them.I am sorry about that but things take more time than I initially thought!:/

If anyone has read so far, thanks a lot, you win my love!
Have a great day!

notes.title: Demo is up for grab!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

First of all I am sorry about the big delay.At first I couldn't publish the demo as it wasn't quite finished and contained major bugs(It still might have, but I tested it with as many people as I can and fixed the stuff)
And yesterday I finally uploaded the demo but it showed an empty folder, I just managed to fix it now.

As for the demo,it is just to show you the core gameplay loop.It lacks some quality of life features such as minimap and other little things,and also lacks enemy types and bosses.

In the demo you will have 2 days(Which is about 48 minutes in real time) to build stuff and explore around, after that the enemies will attack your village and the demo will end.

The vision I have about this game is to give you the joy of exploring new stuff and also she satisfaction of building a village and successfully defending it.

[b]Please report any bugs or suggestions in our discord channel or steam forums.

Thanks again, have a great day![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #5 Port,Buildings,Delay
notes.content:
Hey guys, I hope you are well,  staying safe and healthy!

Sorry for the late update, been busy fixing some bugs and adding features as well as real life stuff.But still, it feels to me time goes by so fast these days :O

So I have a bunch of gifs for you if you are interested in how things work.

I made it so that villagers need to carry required resources in order to build stuff.And I have added building animation and particle effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/9eb41c3a11448197d32854b2ee114db1303ab985.gif[/img]

Upgrades and decorations such as lamps gets built instantly at the moment for convenience, but I might change that if people think it breaks the immersion.

I have made it so that you can assign people to work on the Port, they will generate gold when idle, and will perform various tasks:Building a ship, carrying back the resources gathered by fishing ships, load the trading ship with required resources for trade routes.

You start by building an exploration/war ship, to which you must assign soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/ee9efdf94d2644e81a8d8cba1a13b8c8d01517f7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/668fa4c4b6717142c1e9f979b632dc596a2c4e7d.gif[/img]

And then select locations to explore on the map and send the ship
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/fe7702d88161a559724a328f2816ed49a78df8c9.gif[/img]

You can send fishing ships to fish after you assign them with villagers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/2d69c101195ebc59a84ee027f71cbc98dc99c8f7.gif[/img]

And they will drop the gathered fish at the Port and go back to fishing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/2ed0c26a1a6b112790642a252782c687051d5e8e.gif[/img]

You can upgrade your ships, I plan to have 3 upgradable versions for each type of ship.This Atakebune ship below will  probably be the max level exploration ship.I have also redrawn the old pirate ship model to make it smaller to fit the size of my new ships.

I am still working on the naval combat and how the melee and cannonball types should work.But I am kinda tired of working on the ocean part of the game, so I will get back to it after working on another part of the game.But I am open to ideas on how we can make the naval combat fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/453e8a0f558d545a707d346034b38d739eeb474d.gif[/img]

Here is a night scene with Port fully upgraded
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/e1d100e4e325c8486ec147c79b17567d86f8e970.gif[/img]


[i][b]To Do List[/b][/i]

I liked the concept of assining people to work on buildings.So I want to add a bit more of those, such as blacksmith building and a sawmill.I need to create a minimap, add random events, fix code(This I must always do somehow lol), work on research tree, add a main character with skills, keep adding new trade routes and a few ocean monsters, puzzles and secret doors at dungeons, and probably bunch of stuff I can't think of right now.

[u][b]Delay[/b][/u]

So I wanted to release the game by the end of Q3 but it seems really hard at this point.Things take longer than I expected, and I try to fix stuff as I go instead of just doing things roughly.And I get stuck on small details being a little perfectionist which is a major issue :/ So I am sorry for the delay.There is a game festival between 7th-13th october, I will hopefully participate in it and have a demo up for 1 week.But I still want to do a closed beta before that if I can.
Believe me there is nobody else but me  who wants to release this game as soon as possible.But it will be ready when it is ready, I don't wanna release a half baked game.

I encourage  new ideas  or criticism from you guys, so that I can fix/implement stuff before it is too late into the development.

Thanks a lot if you have read through this long post, and it's okay if you haven't, I still love you.Have fun!

notes.title: Mini devlog #3, Trading & Exploration
notes.content:
Hello guys!I hope you are safe and well.

I have been working on the exploration and trading part of the game.After you explore new lands, you will be able to establish trade routes with them, you will receive gold and relationship experience every few days/hours depending on the distance, in exchange for the resources the city wants to buy.And with the relationship points you can unlock new stuff at certain thresholds, these will be a mixture of decorations,new tech/bonuses,a few units.Here is a demonstration:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/b553aaa48bb3b403845ed6eb7e326bd0698a5724.gif[/img]

I have also added shipwrecks and fishing spots to the map.Each spots contains a few fish type which you gather randomly, and shipwrecks contain some shiny rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/765445cb1f68c33faa76d7b3e4e61be0428da58f.gif[/img]

Still working on how you should assign workers to those tasks.It will probably work like this:You assign villagers to the docks, and they will automaticaly assign themselves to the task once you click on it on the map if you have enough ships/space.

The project has become much more complex than I initially planned for(It was supposed to be a very simple village defending game haha) which is a common beginners mistake that I tried to avoid but still failed.And as a result I felt a bit overwhelmed and over my head and couldnt work efficiently for about a week or so.But things are back on track now, I am hoping to finish the mechanics part of the system and about 4 cities close by the next week.

Thanks all for reading and your support!If you have any suggestions or question let me know, you can always message me directly at our discord channel : [url=https://discord.gg/nc26Eaq]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Mini Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello guys, hope you are safe and well!

A small update on what I have been up to over the past 2 weeks.I have redesigned the unit trait system, previously units had 1 to 3 bonuses based on their rarity, those bonuses could be negative or positive.I have felt it was too limiting hence the redesign.Units now have 10 talents each, they are randomized at the start, but they will level up their talents when they work on appropriate jobs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/0010878c4817f810ffd089d13208dff34c856b19.gif[/img]

I have worked on the elemental power users, the monks.There are 4 types of monks:Earth,Fire,Water,Air.(I have plans for a fifth one later on(Aether)).They have 2 skills each, one is a basic ability and the other is a special ability with a cooldown, which you can cast manualy if you want(This might change on final build).I have finished all of them except for the air monk's basic ability.Here are some screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/80ca0dbc06c676ec7edc36aab96a5a987339eb40.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/f7273b4c1b715a701d7c086d7961ec5805dc2cb0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/07eff3b44898e4458e36b89976fba792672b5353.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37927499/f3810b26cc2dc011fc9f48130a85154049bf33dd.gif[/img]

I have also been coding, which takes quite a bit of time as well, all the systems I have shown so far are functional.I am trying to prepare a short playable build for a closed beta hopefully late july/early august(I am a solo dev working on his first game so I might be bad at predicting dates, take it as  a rough estimate :(

We are close to 1k whishlists and 100 followers, so I thank each one of you!Means a lot.

Join our discord channel if you have any questions/suggestions or just want to chat!

[url=https://discord.gg/nc26Eaq]Discord Channel[/url]
